# Let me find all complete horizontal lines of 6s and complete vertical lines of 6s
def find_complete_lines(grid, color):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = []
    vertical = []
    
    # Find complete horizontal lines
    for r in range(H):
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for c in range(W)):
            horizontal.append(r)
    
    # Find complete vertical lines
    for c in range(W):
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(H)):
            vertical.append(c)
    
    return horizontal, vertical
